applicabilityBasis.summary: HOLLAR is a general dollar-oriented overcollateralized currency minted through protocol borrowing and the HSM. Debt repayment releases collateral; HSM buying of HOLLAR is conditional on liquidity and module parameters. Reviewed material does not identify a legal issuer obligated to redeem holders for fixed national-currency monetary value. The dollar/payment design prevents a confident non-payment-token conclusion.

references.label: Hydration HOLLAR minting and Stability Module
GENIUS Act: monetary value and issuer redemption obligation

genius.notes: No legal issuing entity or unconditional fixed-dollar issuer redemption undertaking was verified. HOLLAR is not GHO and collateral-token licenses do not authorize HOLLAR. DAO governance and protocol overcollateralization do not independently prove statutory exemption. No named GENIUS authorization or announced route was located in the checked public sources; this is not a finding of non-compliance.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The public sources checked did not locate a HOLLAR/Hydration GENIUS approval, public official application, state qualification, foreign registration or issuer-announced pathway. Implementation proposals and state-certification procedures are not token approvals. NYDFS ordinary licensing/Greenlist is not GENIUS qualification. The review cannot exclude unpublished applications or establish illegality.
